rationale: Option B explicitly addresses the question: identical wording across conditions with the trigger as the only change, plus multiple samples (ten) at fixed temperature, so variation among samples reflects model stochasticity. This is also cheap and practical, which fits a resource-conscious evaluator. Option A stresses fixed wording reused across models and seeds, but it never specifies multiple samples per prompt or the trigger-only difference, so it is less directly on point.
